environment.dataset_provenance: Synthetic domain-grounded benchmark fixture for Cortex hybrid retrieval, constructed from representative personal knowledge vault topics (software architecture, RAG indexing, Apple Silicon thermal policy, food chemistry, and temporal logs).
environment.dataset_limitations: Small-scale (25 queries across 11 notes); focused on deterministic regression testing, component ablation, and dense/hybrid ranking calibration. Not intended for macro web search evaluation.
